title: lore-cli session handoff 2026-11-06: 0.15.0 rc.1 staged on both packages, latest not moved, operator moves it
description:
Session-handoff record for the lore-cli worker, 2026-11-06, written for the DEC-260 (3) wave-1 build-only renewal onto Claude Code 2.1.318, as the ODOC-480 ruling requires (the previous handoff LCLI-787 was closed spent on 2026-11-04). Restore with opum-workflow:opum-handoff; the live tracker and repository outrank this note. Close it once a successor has restored from it; the next renewal writes a fresh one.

STATE read by ref 2026-11-06 after a fetch, clean tree. origin/dev == cc48f258a60012a96c56147a91303f3c9cf0987f (the 2026-11-04 grooming PR lore-cli#717). origin/main == 7b6176842e18c929039b155706b6a537130993eb, so dev is 4 commits ahead (#714, #715, #716, #717, all tracker only) and 0 behind; none is promoted and none needs promotion for the cut. Tag v0.15.0: tag object e9a27a6c09faf8326e6c8f94fd259d4216285908, peeled commit 7b617684, skills/ tree a64e795ea6d2b18ba1351b6e6b080d0a245d738b. Release run of record 41321407675 (leader relay; I never read its metadata). npm read with --prefer-online: @opum-ai/lore and @opum-ai/quest both read release-candidate 0.15.0-rc.1 and latest 0.14.1, so both rc.1 are STAGED (by the operator own script, part D) and latest has NOT moved. In Progress in the tracker: LCLI-751, 760, 768, 771, 775; I have been working none of them since 2026-11-02.

OPEN. LCLI-775 (the 0.15.0 cut) waits on opum-cli-e2e pair receipt receipts/pair/0.15.0.json, then QUEST latest first, then the operator lore latest move; tag, publish and the latest move are the operator own dialog (tier 3), never mine. Commands, read by ref at v0.15.0 (scripts/ identical on dev): node scripts/promote-latest.mjs --record <file> --version 0.15.0 --release-run 41321407675 then --dry-run or --promote; --rollback <file> stands alone; never unpublish. The dry run refuses until quest latest reads 0.15.0, and that check reads once with no retry (promote-latest.mjs 1746-1760), so a registry lag refuses harmlessly and a re-run is fine. The script never prompts: auth is Keychain npm-opum-ai-publish, then NPM_TOKEN, then ~/.npmrc plus an optional --otp. Success line: Promoted: latest reads 0.15.0 on all 7 packages (2023). Exit 3 = COMPLETE and verified with the GitHub Release or readme read-back not done: never roll back on 3. It cuts the GitHub Release itself from CHANGELOG [0.15.0]. LCLI-786 (publish-release.sh install smoke fails ETARGET over a complete publish; gate reads npm view once at line 1001, smoke runs one npx at 1486) is filed and UNSTARTED, waiting on the plan approval opum-doc relays; its root cause is deliberately unclaimed. Carried to the 2026-11-11 Wednesday grooming: LCLI-530 (the ruling said add the quest-cli dependency but names no quest-cli task; left unchanged, leader carries it for opum-doc to name one or rule it lore-only) and the ODOC-231 A/B, which lore-cli puts to opum-doc as one A/B (what remains of git-grounded versioning; LCLI-546 to 551 are parked low behind LCLI-546; LCLI-548 was checked against LCLI-565 and is NOT covered by it). Also carried: LCLI-781 (remove both QUEST_SOURCE_REF pins once quest 0.15.0 is on npm latest), LCLI-782 (DEC-249, waits for a brief after the pair ships), LCLI-760, LCLI-776, LCLI-646 (held).

OWED AFTER LATEST MOVES (mine, not tier 3). 1) LCLI-469 marketplace message 2: tell opum-marketplace dist-tags.latest reads 0.15.0 and resend tag v0.15.0, tag object e9a27a6c, peeled 7b617684, skills/ tree a64e795e, to be re-resolved; the pin bump must carry a lore schema export under 0.15.0. Message 1 WAS sent 2026-11-01 (OMARK-107, opum-ai/opum-marketplace#239); do not resend it. 2) Tell quest-cli, opum-cli-e2e (information) and opum-agent that lore is live. 3) Update docs/reference/lore-cli-release-truth.md by branch and PR to dev: 0.15.0 released, run 41321407675, the promotion record path, the A4 VERDICT line, and that publish-release.sh staging carries no provenance attestation.

FACTS THAT COST TIME. Local quest is 0.14.1, so lore check refuses on the pair lock locally; CI supplies quest. The ownership hook refuses a shell variable in a path argument: use literal paths. zsh set -- does not split. The Monitor tool schema must be loaded with ToolSearch first. SendMessage shutdown replies need the structured object form, and its schema must be loaded first. A composed git push is refused whole. Read CI by FULL head SHA and require total 14 with 0 not completed; merge bare with --match-head-commit. Required contexts on dev: read ruleset 22838594 live (six at last read). Keep the review worktrees (DEC-208): review-702-5d54541, review-702b-ea7ca08, review-712-ee89422, review-712b-ada4d73.
